concerns.text: FR-006 requires acquiring Common Crawl subsets (French/Chinese) with ≥1M tokens. The plan (research.md, Dataset Strategy) admits 'No verified direct URL for specific FR/CN Common Crawl subsets' and proposes using RedPajama filtered by language code as a fallback. This fallback does not satisfy the explicit requirement to acquire Common Crawl subsets, leaving FR-006 unbacked by a concrete data acquisition task in the plan.

FR-007 requires acquiring and processing WALS features. The plan (research.md, Dataset Strategy) states 'No verified URL in block' and proposes a fallback of 'Data Unavailable' if no open source exists. This contingency plan does not constitute a task to 'acquire and process' the data as mandated by FR-007; the success criterion (SC-004) relies on this data, creating a gap where the plan may skip the requirement entirely without a defined mitigation task.

FR-008 requires implementing a vocabulary mapping layer. The plan mentions 'shared subword vocabulary mapping layer' in risks (research.md) but lacks a dedicated phase, data model entity, or explicit implementation step in the Technical Context or Project Structure to address this specific requirement. The plan assumes alignment but does not detail the mechanism required to satisfy FR-008.
